description:
There is no type of bike that benefits from custom design and construction more than a road bike. As you settle into a riding position for 10/15/120 minutes at a time on your favorite stretch of road, nothing short of a precise fit will allow you to ride comfortably and efficiently. As you pedal over uneven pavement, 28-32mm tires will only absorb so much, and tubing dimensions that match your frame’s size, your riding style, and your preferences become that much more crucial to keep the bike firmly planted on the ground and keep your bones happy for as many miles as your legs can keep turning. As you descend mountain passes on those same skinny tires, a geometry designed to work in harmony with your riding position is the key to an exhilarating yet confident ride.

Everything that makes custom great is amplified on a custom road bike. We can’t wait to build yours.

Ideal terrain: Well paved roads, not-so-well paved roads, maintained dirt roads
